header.intro: Fifteen years in Portland multifamily. More than a decade as an apartment owner. An approach grounded in experience, sound advice, and strong negotiation.

bio.headline: Real estate was part of my life long before it became my career.
paragraphs: Some of my earliest memories involve accompanying my parents to their two apartment buildings — a fourplex and a fiveplex. There were units to paint, appliances to repair, landscaping to maintain, and prospective tenants to meet. As a kid, I wasn't particularly excited about spending my weekends at the apartments. Fortunately, I could usually bring a toy or two to pass the time.

It wasn't until I was older that I began to appreciate what those investments meant to our family. My parents were ordinary, hardworking people who had created something valuable through years of effort and commitment. Their apartments provided financial opportunities that might not otherwise have been possible.

As I built my career in multifamily brokerage, I began to see those properties differently. I recognized opportunities to improve their performance, make more strategic investment decisions, and grow what my parents had started. Over time, I've been fortunate to help our family expand that original investment into a much larger portfolio.
Today, I see firsthand how thoughtful real estate decisions can shape a family's financial future, not just for the current owners, but for the generations that follow.

That perspective is at the heart of Gerding Commercial Real Estate. I understand the work that goes into owning apartment buildings, the opportunities they create, and the importance of making the right decisions along the way.

perspective.headline: Brokerage experience. Ownership perspective.
paragraphs: Owning apartment buildings brings a different understanding to the brokerage business. Cash flow, financing, capital improvements, taxes, and long-term investment decisions aren't just concepts I discuss with clients. They're considerations I've navigated myself.
That experience influences how I evaluate properties, approach negotiations, and advise owners on their options.
perspective.approachHeadline: Good relationships are built over time.
approachParagraphs: I started Gerding CRE because I believe apartment owners deserve an advisor, not a salesperson. Someone who will tell you the market isn't right to sell yet. Someone who helps you think through a 1031 exchange before you've even listed.
My goal is to be the person you call years before you make a move — and years after. That long-term relationship is the foundation this firm is built on.

negotiation.headline: The right strategy matters. The right execution matters more.
paragraphs: A successful transaction requires more than finding a buyer. It requires preparation, an understanding of the market, and the judgment to recognize which buyers can perform and which terms matter most.

Negotiation is where much of that preparation pays off. Knowing when to push, how to defend a property's value, and how to protect the seller's position through closing can make a meaningful difference in the outcome.

points.title: Buyer relationships
points.body: Years of working with multifamily investors provide insight into who's actively buying, what they're looking for, and which buyers are positioned to perform.

points.title: Strategic positioning
points.body: Every property has strengths worth emphasizing. Effective pricing and positioning create interest, establish credibility, and provide a foundation for negotiation.

points.title: NEGOTIATING JUDGMENT
points.body: The highest offer isn't always the best offer. Buyer qualifications, financing, contingencies, and timing all influence the strength of a transaction.

points.title: Disciplined execution
points.body: From the initial marketing strategy through due diligence and closing, attention to detail and proactive communication help keep the transaction moving.

cta.headline: You don't need to be ready to sell to reach out.
cta.body: Whether you're considering a sale, evaluating an investment, or simply looking for another perspective, I'm always happy to talk. Some of the best relationships begin with a conversation long before there's a transaction.
